scope: B06-03 E06 lines 196–219 scoped local only

groups.contract: Inputs detector, family, number, parent type and object, exact parent stop event, nine-item OrderMatch and source triple; return annotation EZone. Postponed annotations do not validate or coerce.

Invoke E03 first; chronology identity (not equality) and non-null dirty required. Dirty retained unchanged. Failure precedes unpack and map access; this gate alone proves neither valid dirty evidence nor native race selection.

Unpack exactly nine items in order: order_number, order, confirmation, level, stop_index, stop_time, crossed, causes, cause_time. Non-iterable or wrong arity raises; no starred fallback. Assert crossed is not None, not truthiness or tuple length; AssertionError in normal assertion mode, omitted under optimization. No alternate selection. Malformed crossing can still fail later; a current hit may bypass crossed[2].

Construct one ordered 26-element tuple left to right: detector.direction; family; number; parent_type; parent.source_index; parent.source_time; str(parent.price); stop_event; order_number; order.first_idx; order.break_idx; order.mode; order.box_top_source_idx; str(order.box_top); order.box_bottom_source_idx; str(order.box_bottom); confirmation; str(level); stop_index; stop_time; crossed; causes; cause_time; source[0]; source[1]; str(source[2]). Retain nested crossing and causes as supplied, not flattened, sorted or normalized. Five explicit strings are representation-sensitive. Decimal 1.0 versus 1.00 compares numerically equal and hashes equally in E04, but their strings differ in E06; signed zero and exponent representations can also differ. No rounding, quantization or normalization. Ordinary dictionary hashing and tuple equality apply elementwise with Python identity/equality behavior; collisions alone are not equality; elements must be hashable. No separate Order object identity, parent object identity, Order direction, First/Break or box-source timestamps, chronology identity/time array, range or feedback scope in key. Their relevant consistency is conditional on native caller/market ownership. Native Order direction derives from detector chronology; builder derives times from positions. Key retains uncoerced indices and mode; builder conversion is separate.

Current dictionary get by complete tuple, None sentinel. Non-null result including a falsey object is a hit; no type check, builder or cutoff evaluation on this route. Attribute, string, subscript, hashing and equality failures propagate.

Only current None evaluates max(stop_event,crossed[2],confirmation) strictly less than dirty. All three comparable event instants must be earlier; equality of maximum excludes previous lookup. No lower or range-end guard; no race recomputation. Max arguments evaluated in order; crossing indexed only on current miss. If strict guard true consult previous dictionary by same tuple. Non-null previous is reused as identical object, no copy, replace or field check. Previous map not mutated.

Remaining None calls detector._build_zone once with seven positional arguments family, number, parent_type, parent, stop_event, original match, original source. No reconstruction from key. Native E32 unpacks again, asserts crossing, computes decision_event=max(stop_event,crossed[2]) (confirmation not in this max), maps decision and parent stop to main positions, uses detector order_direction and indexed times; normalizes parent and box prices via as_decimal, int-converts selected indices, str-converts mode, retains provided source price, Order stop level, cause tuple and exact event times. Constructs frozen slotted EZone with 35 declared fields. E06 does not validate return type or value, including None from custom builder. Dynamic calls and failures propagate.

Unconditional current-map assignment after current hit, previous hit or successful build, then return exactly the selected reference. No mutation of previous map or zone fields, no copying. Ordinary dict insertion adds encounter order, overwrite does not move an existing equal key. Failed gate, unpack, key construction, lookup, cutoff or builder prevents final explicit write; assignment can itself fail. No try, rollback, cleanup or compensation for prior dynamic side effects or upstream ledger changes. No promise of behavior on malformed custom objects; annotations are not enforcement.

findings.description: Revalidated B06-03-F1 and clarified ordered 26-element representation-sensitive key, omitted identity/time fields, current hit bypass, strict previous guard, native race precondition and no rollback.

limitations: Separate source-first local forensic review by GPT, not independently staffed. Existing AST inventories directly compared, not regenerated.
Local source-only scope; no RAW payload, runtime, ZIP, production or main change, new cross-owner acceptance or empirical cache equivalence.

Prior 563 row identities, operations, spans, historical W1 dispositions/interpretations and six supplemental identities checked against pinned artifacts; semantic contracts re-read by groups, not re-executed. All 1109 CP317 links checked against canonical inventory, W1 crosswalk and partitions; historical 25-partition reconciliation retained from predecessor, not all historical partitions fetched anew.

Ordinary native object, hashable tuple members, finite Decimal representation, comparable times, stable omitted-field consistency and valid dirty evidence remain conditional. No assertion malformed input is reachable.
